definitions: To resolve or reach an agreement about an argument or problem.
To make a place your permanent home.
To become or make somebody become calm, quiet, or comfortable.
To pay money that is owed.
To move downwards and stay in a particular position or place.
To become still and clear after being disturbed.
examples: They hope to settle the dispute soon.
The baby settled down for a nap.
I need to settle my account.
The mud settled at the bottom of the pond.
